chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: 1927 itinerary: Mineral Wells, Austin, Mississippi flood and Lexington
summary: Lists engagements across Texas, Mississippi and Lexington, including a flood in Jackson in 1927.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I got a couple of other places that you played in; the Crazy House in Mineral Wells, Stephen Hotel in Austin.
Stephen F. Austin--that was the name.
Then you toured Mississippi, Lake Charles, Lafayette. (Inaudible) himself said he played New Orleans, but you don't remember playing New Orleans.
In Jackson, Mississippi, there was something about a flood, a flood caught up with you there?
A flood caught up with us.
That was in '27, had to be '27.
Then Lexington came the Rosland Ballroom and the Phoenix--that was in the Phoenix Hotel?
